title: Polish: unverified quotes
question: PRODUCT.md says the home quotes aren’t confirmed evidence. How should polish handle them?

options.label: Remove the quote cards
options.thesis: Drop both review cards so nothing reads as social proof until you have real ones.
options.case: Clears the P0 integrity issue cleanly; About / Why keep their content.
options.risk: Pages lose visual balance in those rows until you add real quotes later.

options.label: Leave quotes as they are
options.thesis: Keep the cards for now; polish everything else.
options.case: Only if you’re about to replace them with real testimonials soon.
options.risk: Parents may still treat unconfirmed quotes as proof.
